title: About
text:
I’m a 4th year PhD candidate studying fire ecology and plant community ecology. I’m based in the Plant Biology program at North Carolina State University, working with Bill Hoffmann. My research focuses on population-, community-, and ecosystem-level responses to variation in stand density and canopy composition in longleaf pine ecosystems.
I’m also the Treasurer of the Plant Biology Graduate Student Association, a Grad Peer Mentor through the College of Agriculture and Life Sciences, and a studio potter and ceramics teacher at the NC State Craft Center.
